A gift of friendship given to you by Hestu. It smells pretty bad.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Hestu's Gift is received from [[Hestu]] at the [[Korok Forest]] after collecting all 900 [[Korok Seed]]s and maxing out all the stashes.{{Cite|Hey! Guess what! All of the forest children returned to Korok Forest! [...] You've maxed all of your {{Color BotW|Blue|stashes}}! So let me give you this!|Hestu|BotW}} It serves no purpose, however, [[Link]] can visit Hestu at any time to see him dance.{{Cite|I hope you'll still visit me. You can watch me dance whenever you want!|Hestu|BotW}}{{Cite|If you have {{Color BotW|Blue|Hestu's gift}}, dance with me!|Hestu|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Hestu's Gift returns in {{TotK}}, where it is received from [[Hestu]] after all collecting all 1,000 [[Korok Seed]]s and fully upgrading [[Link]]'s [[Inventory]].{{Cite|Shaka?! You collected all the Korok seeds! Amazing! ♪Ama-sa-sing, I'ma gonna sing, amaza-zing! Super-super amazing!♪ You've maxed all of your stashes. So let me give you this, as thanks.|Hestu|TotK}} Its sprite has been updated to include four layers instead of {{BotW}}'s three. It still has no gameplay function, but it allows Link to visit Hestu at any time to watch him dance.{{Cite|So? Do you like it? With that, you can—wait for it—watch me dance whenever you want! But that's not all! I can also share a classic dance with ya. So! You just come and find me whenever you wanna shaka-shaka!|Hestu|TotK}} Link can also ask to see Hestu's "classic" dance, wherein Hestu performs the {{BotW|-}} version of his Inventory expansion dance. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hestu * Korok Seed }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |items= BotW, TotK |key-items= BotW, TotK }}
